Kids Lifeline

Storytime with Zaza and Zuzu: an emergency audio initiative by BBC Media Action for Palestinian children affected by war and displacement.

Country

BBC Media Action
Role
Co-creator, Director & Lead Producer
Award
BBC News Award, Outstanding Initiative for Reaching Underserved Audiences

The project

The story behind it.

The project

Kids Lifeline serves Palestinian children affected by severe war and displacement, offering them comfort through audio stories.

What she did

Working in a crisis-communication capacity, Khadija led the implementation of mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS), woven into creative audio storytelling.

Impact

The programme brought comforting stories to children in conflict zones, offering emotional relief, learning and moments of imaginative escape. It received the BBC News Award for Outstanding Initiative for Reaching Underserved Audiences.
